gwen.speaker: Gwen
gwen.text: Welcome to 'THE TAVERN', traveler. I'm Gwen, the owner of this place! Tell me, where are you from...

options.text: I come from No man's land, the place where the neverending war is fought.
I come from nowhere and I'm going everywhere. I'd reather not talk to you now so stop asking questions.

gwen.speaker: Gwen
gwen.text: Oh dear, that's far away, you must be tired now! Let me get you a meal, it's on the house.

options.text: Thank you very much! That's exacty what I need right now.

gwen.speaker: Gwen
gwen.text: How rude! You better not bring any truble, these lands are already dangerous on their own.

options.text: No need to worry, lady. I'm just here for a meal, just give me one and no truble will be brought

aer_wizard.speaker: Aer Wizard
aer_wizard.text: Goblins are invading our lands! Will you help us?
